page.title: Instrument language
page.purpose: Render every primitive of the vrooli-annunciator design language in every state it can be in, on one page. It exists so the language can be reviewed as a whole before a real surface consumes it, and so a regression in a primitive is visible without reading a diff.

priorities.statement: The data on this page is fixed, and the page says so.
priorities.notes: A style fixture that reads live data stops being a fixture the first time the host changes: a state that no longer occurs silently stops being reviewed. Every value here is a chosen sample, and the annunciator grid's caption states that plainly so no reader mistakes these rows for a measurement of this machine.

priorities.statement: Every state in the vocabulary appears, including the ones that are easy to forget.
priorities.notes: The nine signal states exist because nine different facts are routinely collapsed into one another. A fixture that renders only the common ones would let the rare distinctions — no cell authored, mechanism absent, source unreachable — drift out of the language unnoticed.

priorities.statement: Status is legible without colour here first.
priorities.notes: If a reviewer cannot tell two states apart on this page with colour removed, no real surface built from these primitives will do better.

states.description: Every primitive renders against its fixed sample data: legend plates, the nine annunciator lamp states, segmented rung rings, stat plates, the annunciator grid, and dated declared-blindness notes.
The page performs no reads, so it has no loading, empty or error state of its own. It renders identically whether or not any source is reachable.

claims.statement: The page states that its data is fixed sample data and not a reading of this host.
claims.rationale: A style fixture mistaken for a live board is worse than no fixture: it invites a reader to act on numbers nobody measured.

claims.statement: All nine signal states appear: covered, partial, excursion, unmeasurable, mechanism absent, not applicable, no cell authored, blind, and source unreachable.
claims.rationale: The vocabulary is closed precisely so these stay distinguishable. A state absent from the fixture is a state nobody is reviewing.

claims.statement: Each state carries a distinct mark and short code, so any two remain distinguishable with colour removed.
claims.rationale: The scenario's status-not-colour-alone claim is only as good as the primitives it is built from, and this is where that is verifiable in one view.

claims.statement: The page performs no API read and offers no control that changes anything.
claims.rationale: It is a rendering of a language, not a view of the plant. Anything it read could fail, and a failing style guide teaches nothing about the language.
